scripts.deps: pnpm --dir deps/celler install --frozen-lockfile --pm-on-fail=ignore && pnpm --dir deps/celler run --pm-on-fail=ignore build && pnpm --dir deps/vindu install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir deps/vindu run build
scripts.lint: oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings packages scripts test && knip && node scripts/check-size.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm run build && node --experimental-transform-types --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --test test/*.test.ts && pnpm run test:pi
scripts.test:pi: python3 -I -B -W error::ResourceWarning -m unittest discover -s pi/setup -t pi/setup
scripts.test:browser: pnpm run build && node --test test/browser.mjs test/browser-workspace.mjs test/browser-turns.mjs test/browser-folder.mjs test/browser-box.mjs test/browser-git.mjs test/browser-tv.mjs && node --experimental-transform-types --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --test test/host-browser.ts
